title: developer.monday.com/apps/docs/partner-program.md
snippet:
The monday app marketplace Partner Program helps support and empower our app developers on their journey toward success. Through this initiative, we strive to provide a collaborative community that nurtures innovation, amplifies exposure, and drives mutual growth.

The Marketplace Partner Program is divided into four tiers: *Platinum*, *Gold*, *Silver*, and *Bronze*. In addition to the requirements all apps must fulfill to be listed in the marketplace (see more [here](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/app-review-checklist)), each tier has additional requirements that your app must meet to participate in the program.
Below, you can find a full breakdown of the requirements according to tier.
| Requirements                                                                                                | Bronze     | Silver     | Gold       | Platinum   |
| :---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- | :--------- |
| [Apps rating](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/marketplace-app-ratings-and-reviews)                   | -          | 4+         | 4+         | 4.5+       |
| [Monetized by monday](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/monetization)                                  | Yes        | Yes        | Yes        | Yes        |
| Customer Service Level Agreement (SLA)                                                                      | < 48 hours | < 48 hours | < 24 hours | < 24 hours |
| [Security Questionnaire](https://forms.monday.com/forms/1e126005a08c78a19ceac5b810fae8b3?r=use1)            | Yes        | Yes        | Yes        | Yes        |
| Minimum marketplace annual recurring revenue (ARR) from monday.com native monetization                      | $5K        | $75K       | $300K      | $1M        |
| Sign [listing agreement](https://monday.com/l/marketplace-developers/monday-com-marketplace-listing-terms/) | Yes        | Yes        | Yes        | Yes        |
| Complete the [app review process](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/submit-your-app)                   | Yes        | Yes        | Yes        | Yes        |
*\*Quarterly performance evaluations will be conducted to ensure that all requirements are met.*

title: monday.com Developer Account — Free Sandbox for App & API Testing
snippet:
A **developer account** (also called a **sandbox account**) is a free monday.com account designed for building and testing [monday apps](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/intro) and [API](https://developer.monday.com/docs/authentication) integrations. It runs in an environment separate from your production or work data, so you can experiment without affecting live workflows.

Developer accounts include everything in the [Free plan](https://support.monday.com/hc/en-us/articles/360010487220-Understanding-the-Free-Plan), plus higher limits and advanced capabilities tailored for app development. They also include select Pro and Enterprise features commonly needed for building and testing apps.
| Feature | Limit |
|---|---|
| monday.com products | Access to all products (Work Management, CRM, Service, Dev, and more) |
| Seats | Up to 10 |
| Items | Up to 1,000 items per product |
| Boards, dashboards, and workdocs | Unlimited |
| Automations | 25,000 actions/month |
| Integrations | 25,000 actions/month |
| API complexity | 10M |
| Permissions | Account-, column-, and item-level permissions |
| Column types | Access to all column types |
| Boards | Private and shareable boards |
| Views | Item and board views |
| Activity log | Tracking and filtering |
| Templates | Included |
| Theme | Hacker theme |

Request additional testing capacity
If your app needs higher limits—for example, more items, automation actions, or API complexity—submit a request through the [marketplace partner extensions form](https://developer-community.monday.com/p/marketplace-partner-extensions). The monday.com team reviews requests within **five business days**.

title: Build on monday.com with AI - MCP, API, and Agent Integration
snippet:

| **Transport** | Hosted remote (Streamable HTTP) | Local via npx |
| **Auth** | OAuth 2.1 | Personal API token |
| **Config** | `"url": "https://mcp.monday.com/mcp"` | `npx @mondaydotcomorg/monday-api-mcp -t <token> --mode apps` |

For use cases that need the full API surface - batch operations, complex nested queries, or direct schema introspection - the monday.com [GraphQL API](https://developer.monday.com/api-reference/reference) is available directly:
```
curl -X POST https://api.monday.com/v2 \
-H "Authorization: <your_token>" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json" \
-H "API-Version: 2026-07" \
-d '{"query": "{ boards (limit: 5) { id name } }"}'
```

You can bring your own agent into monday.com as a first-class participant. Connected agents authenticate with their own API token and operate within the permission scope granted by the account admin.

OAuth 2.1
The Platform MCP uses OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code Grant. monday.com is the identity provider.
1. MCP client redirects to `https://auth.monday.com/oauth2/authorize`
2. User approves requested [permission scopes](https://developer.monday.com/apps/docs/oauth#set-up-permission-scopes)
3. Client exchanges the authorization code for an access token
All MCP tool calls execute in the context of the authenticated user - scoped to that user's platform permissions. No privilege elevation is possible.
##
Token strategy
- **Personal tokens** mirror your UI permissions. Use for individual development.
- **App tokens** have explicit permission scopes (e.g., `boards:read`, `boards:write`). Use for production apps and agents that should have minimum required access.
- Token lifecycle management (storage, rotation, revocation) is the developer's responsibility.

title: Rate limits — monday.com API
snippet:
The limit varies based on how you're making the call:
| Usage | Limit |
|---|---|
| Individual query | 5,000,000 (5M) complexity points |
| Using app tokens to access the API | Read and writes are limited to 5M complexity points per minute* each |
| Using API playground to access the API | Reads and writes are limited to 5M complexity points per minute* each or 1M for trial/free accounts |
| Using personal API tokens to access the API | Reads and writes have a combined budget of 10M points per minute* or 1M for trial, NGO, and free accounts |
